title: [BirthFace B3] Clarify Crèche headings, editable name and Birth review
body:
Parent: #5357 (native usability). Coordinate source projection with #5356/#5604 (canonical Crèche semantics), source/Mask law #5355 and reading/accessibility #5367. Third quick win from the 2026-10-18 QEMU Crèche review.

## Outcome
A human sees **one clear title**, a visible named/editable Body field, a coherent starting-Plot group, a concise source-backed readiness/review summary and one prominent Birth action, rather than several repeated `A body of your own` lines, verbose paragraph duplication and indistinguishable information/control rows.

## Existing behavior to inspect
- `plots/birth/src/widget_face.rs` emits the heading, name/naming fields, choice group, selected-count status, verbose `Review Birth choices` sentence and list of selected Plot status entries.
- `plots/birth/src/face/projection.rs` supplies Host/main/article/navigation subjects, copies heading text, and includes a special `document/precedes` relationship to keep current native focus/navigation working.
- `targets/conduitos/src/native_face_scene/document.rs` turns source subjects and actions into rows; the current QEMU scene visibly repeats the title and reads like a technical utterance list.
- The actual name input action already exists: `creche.name` with a typed text argument. Preserve it rather than drawing an uncontrolled free-text box.

## Bounded implementation
1. Audit which repeats are duplicate **rendered expressions of the same source meaning** versus separately required Face subjects/disclosure. Render one human-facing heading; preserve all distinct authoritative names and full accessible/inspectable Face details. Do not fix duplicates by dropping essential semantic truth.
2. Present `Friendly Body name` with its current typed value as an obviously editable control, using the same exact source action, current input binding, permitted Unicode and bounded text contract. Distinguish editing/draft from committed value; never silently mutate source state from Mask-local text.
3. Make `Naming tradition` / `Suggest another name` secondary but discoverable; show Plot choice/count and concise Birth-ready vs unavailable reason from actual draft truth, not renderer guesswork.
4. Prefer meaningful short authored review wording plus selected Plot names in a grouped, reachable review/details projection. Don't repeat `Starting Plot N` and choice names in the primary panel when the checked inventory is already present; don't hide selected names merely because search filters the editable inventory.
5. Keep Birth primary action tied only to its existing offered source action and actual availability. Refactor special `document/precedes` ordering only with explicit keyboard navigation/focus regression proof, not as a cosmetic rewrite. Keep native/browser/linear semantic reconstruction correct.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Crèche native primary Show has one human-facing `A body of your own` title (or the one actual source title), a visibly editable current Body name, clearly named Plot-selection group, concise review/readiness, and a single prominent offered Birth action.
- [ ] Editing/confirming a new Unicode name and selecting a naming tradition route through their existing checked typed Face actions; suggested name is source-owned and review refreshes on acknowledged Show.
- [ ] A disabled/unavailable Birth explains the source reason. Search filtering never makes selected Plots unreviewable.
- [ ] Reordered visual grouping does not change required Face meaning/disclosure, keyboard focus sequence or accessible names; compare native, browser and linear projections with evidence.
- [ ] Tests cover empty and long name, many Plots, search-filtered list, disabled Birth, stale Show, and 1- and 2-column QEMU presentations. All mandatory fields/actions remain reachable without 48-command/192-byte overflow or silent truncation.

## Stop line
This is an editorial/source projection plus Mask rendering correction, **not** a new Birth workflow, UI-owned form reducer, component DSL or permission to remove a meaningful subject. One small PR and source-pinned regression suite; coordinate with #5604, #5607 and #5520.
